findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "soap-contracts_wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compare a caller-supplied WSDL 1.1 document and its XSD documents, including an optional previous set. audit_status is valid, warnings, breaking_changes, invalid, or incomplete. Imports are not downloaded. A schema difference is syntactic and is not proof that a SOAP client fails at runtime. Price $" → after: "Compare a caller-supplied WSDL 1.1 document and its XSD documents, including an optional previous set. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/soap-contracts/wsdl-xsd-dependency-audit Keywords: when reviewing a SOAP contract or WSDL, schemas, previous, clients, audit status, audit_status, dependency"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
